variants.specifics: Brackenford: Wenna the miller's widow: the Urchins stole the mill key and locked her out, and Tobin went after them with her frying pan and never came back.

offer.speaker: Wenna
offer.text:
Oh, it's hopeless! Hopeless!

The Urchins from the old barrow east of the ford got into my mill and ran off with the mill key! Now I'm locked out of my own mill! Those wretched Urchins are a plague on honest folk!

Tobin went after them with my good frying pan, and he hasn't come back. Will you go into the barrow and bring back my key? I will offer a worthy reward.

refusal.speaker: Wenna
refusal.text: Don't play coy with me stranger. You're scared, that's all. Tobin went with a frying pan, nothing more. Come back when you've found your nerve.

reminder.speaker: Wenna
reminder.text: It is high time you were on your way. Poor Tobin grows hungrier with every hour he's gone.

completion.speaker: Wenna
completion.text:
My key! You found my key! Now the wheel can turn again!

May all that is great bless you! Please, take this ankh as a token of my appreciation.

after.speaker: Wenna
after.text: My endless thanks for your trouble!

journal.text: Find the key to Wenna's mill in the old barrow.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Find the key to Wenna's mill in the old barrow.

variants.specifics: Krennack: Fennick the prospector cannot find a scrap of ore without his Singing Pick, which the Imps snatched from his hands.

offer.speaker: Fennick
offer.text:
Gone! My Singing Pick is gone! Those wretched Imps snatched it right out of my hands while I was eating my lunch!

Without that pick I couldn't find gold in a goldsmith's shop! I'm ruined!

The Imps have a nest down the old West Shaft. Will you get my pick back for me, young sir?

refusal.speaker: Fennick
refusal.text: You've made up your mind then. Sorry the Imps aren't in the habit of giving things back.

reminder.speaker: Fennick
reminder.text: One of the cart boys heard singing from the Imp nest. You just have to follow it!

completion.speaker: Fennick
completion.text: My pick! Listen to her sing! I never thought I'd hear that sweet sound again! Here, take this gold, with an old man's thanks!

after.speaker: Fennick
after.text: Thanks again for helping a poor broke old digger.

journal.text: Imps have stolen Fennick's Singing Pick -- hunt them down and bring it back!

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Imps have stolen Fennick's Singing Pick -- hunt them down and bring it back!

variants.specifics: Skell: Old Ysolt paid all her gold for the Moon Amulet, sold to her by an Urchin in a big hat, and the Urchins stole it back that night.

offer.speaker: Ysolt
offer.text:
Oh, I'm a silly old fool! A pedlar came by yesterday with a magic amulet -- the Moon Amulet, he called it. I paid him every coin I had!

That very night it was stolen right off my table. And the pedlar? He was an Urchin in a big hat! They've sold that same amulet to half the village!

The Urchins hide in the hollow tree west of here. Will you get my amulet back, kind sir? I'll find some way to repay you.

refusal.speaker: Ysolt
refusal.text: You haven't got the nerve. Come see me when you find it.

reminder.speaker: Ysolt
reminder.text: Quickly, kind stranger! Those Urchins could be selling my amulet to someone else right now!

completion.speaker: Ysolt
completion.text: My Moon Amulet! Oh, bless you, kind sir, bless you! I spent all my gold on it, so please take this spell book instead. I hope it serves you well.

journal.text: Recover Ysolt's amulet... before it's sold again.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Ysolt's amulet... before it's sold again.

variants.specifics: Varrok: An Urchin Shaman turned Pruett's husband into a goat, and the Urchins stole the moonstone amulet that could break the curse.

offer.speaker: Pruett
offer.text:
Please, kind sir, you must help me! It's the most horrible thing!

An Urchin Shaman put a curse on my husband, and now he's a goat! A goat! He's chewed up half the laundry already.

I could break the spell with my moonstone amulet, but the Urchins stole it off my windowsill and ran off to their caves north of the castle. Will you bring back my amulet? I'll reward you, I promise.

refusal.speaker: Pruett
refusal.text: You haven't the heart for it. Come back when you've found some.

reminder.speaker: Pruett
reminder.text: Now that you've promised, you'd better hurry back with my amulet!

completion.speaker: Pruett
completion.text:
My amulet! Oh, bless you!

There... the curse is broken! He's my husband again! Oh, thank you, thank you! Here, take this shield. It's the least I can do.

journal.text: Fetch Pruett's amulet from the Urchin caves.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Fetch Pruett's amulet from the Urchin caves.

variants.specifics: Kesk: Wessa needs her Fishing Amulet, stolen off her boat by the Urchins, to win the Mayor's fishing contest.

offer.speaker: Wessa
offer.text:
Rotten little thieves! The Urchins came in the night and took my Fishing Amulet right off my boat!

The Mayor's fishing contest is in a few days. Without that amulet I won't catch a thing! It makes the fish practically leap into the net. Well... it's not cheating if nobody finds out.

Their caves are up on the north shore. Will you get it back for me?

refusal.speaker: Wessa
refusal.text: Not feeling brave enough yet, eh? No matter, the contest isn't till the end of the week. If you change your mind, just come and find me.

reminder.speaker: Wessa
reminder.text: The Urchin caves are up past the big rock, you can't miss them.

completion.speaker: Wessa
completion.text:
My amulet! Oh, you wonderful thing! Those fish don't stand a chance now!

Here, take this Ankh as a token of my appreciation. And not a word to anyone about the contest!

after.speaker: Wessa
after.text: Old Tolbek came by asking after you. He says he'll be waiting at the end of the long pier.

journal_done.text: The Fishing Amulet is back with Wessa.

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Hesk the scribe's Golden Quill, which writes the College's scrolls by itself, was stolen by the Urchins of the Old Quarry, and his shop is ruined.

offer.speaker: Hesk
offer.text:
Ruined! I'm ruined!

Urchins broke into my shop last night and stole my Golden Quill! It writes the scrolls all by itself -- every spell scroll the College buys comes from that quill! Without it I can't fill a single order, and Arch-Mage Tollund will take his business elsewhere!

The little thieves hide in the Old Quarry, west of town. Will you get my quill back?

refusal.speaker: Hesk
refusal.text: You don't have a minute for a ruined man.

completion.speaker: Hesk
completion.text:
My quill! My beautiful quill! I'm back in business!

Thank you, Wanderer. Take this Ankh and these 50 gold pieces. You've saved my shop!

after.speaker: Hesk
after.text: You know, I've been busy... that quill hasn't stopped scribbling since you brought it back!

journal.text: Recover Hesk's Golden Quill from the Urchins of the Old Quarry.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Hesk's Golden Quill from the Urchins of the Old Quarry.

variants.specifics: Ulmgard: Tibbet the furrier's shop is ruined since rogues took his magic shears to the old toll house down the west road.

offer.speaker: Tibbet
offer.text:
Ruined! I'm ruined! Rogues broke into my shop last night and took my magic shears! Without them I can't cut a single fur, and the whole garrison is waiting on winter coats!

Those thieves are holed up in the old toll house down the west road. Will you get my shears back for me, young sir?

refusal.speaker: Tibbet
refusal.text: Come back when you feel braver.

reminder.speaker: Tibbet
reminder.text: Those rogues must be laughing at me right now!

completion.speaker: Tibbet
completion.text:
My shears! Oh, my beautiful shears! Now I can get back to work!

I can't offer much till the coats are sold, but take these boots. A token of my appreciation!

after.speaker: Tibbet
after.text: Please, don't block my doorway. I'm swamped with work.

journal.text: Go to the toll house and take back Tibbet's shears.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Go to the toll house and take back Tibbet's shears.

variants.specifics: Kalgarr: Warden Fusk must by the town charter fetch back the Fire Amulet the Imps stole from the Guild vault, and would much rather the player went.

offer.speaker: Fusk
offer.text:
Bah! Those wretched Imps are the bane of my existence! They crept into the Guild vault last night and carried off the Fire Amulet!

And who must go and fetch it back? The Warden! It's written right there in the town charter! Well, I've a bad knee and I don't care for Imps one bit.

They've dug their burrows in the Ash Pits, south of the smelters. Would you go down there and bring the Amulet back for me, kind sir? There's a reward in it for you.

refusal.speaker: Fusk
refusal.text: So that's how you treat old Fusk and his Imp problem! Thanks a lot!

reminder.speaker: Fusk
reminder.text: Maybe if you poked through all the hottest holes and smelliest burrows you could turn up that Amulet in those stinking pits!

completion.speaker: Fusk
completion.text: The Fire Amulet! You've found it! Now nobody can say the Warden didn't do his duty! Please, take this Ankh as a token of my appreciation.

after.speaker: Fusk
after.text: Thank you. I reckon you've earned my badge more than I have.

journal.text: Recover the Fire Amulet for Fusk.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover the Fire Amulet for Fusk.

variants.specifics: Torvel: Nella's husband Gorvin turned into a goat when the Urchins of the Pitch Caves stole his Amulet of Warding.

offer.speaker: Nella
offer.text:
Oh, it's terrible! My husband Gorvin has been turned into a goat!

Those thieving Urchins crept in last night and took his Amulet of Warding right off the bedpost. He never takes it off! And the moment it was gone... BAAAAA!

The Urchins hide in the Pitch Caves, east of the crossroads. Please, will you bring back the Amulet?

reminder.speaker: Nella
reminder.text: Gorvin ate the curtains again this morning, lad. Search where the Urchins hide -- deep inside those caves. Bring the Amulet straight back from there.

completion.speaker: Nella
completion.text:
The Amulet! You found it!

Gorvin! Come here, Gorvin! ... Oh! He's himself again! Thank you, thank you, kind sir! Please, take this Ankh. May all that is great bless you!

after.speaker: Nella
after.text: Everyone's talking about how you thrashed those Urchins! Bless you!

journal.text: Find the Pitch Caves east of the crossroads. The Urchins hiding there have stolen the Amulet of Warding from Nella's house.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Find the Pitch Caves and return the Amulet of Warding to Nella.

variants.writer: Claude Agent SDK subagent, Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5)

variants.specifics: Durnhal: Posey wore her mother's Rain Amulet to the harvest dance and Urchins snatched it; it must be back on its hook before her mother comes home from market.

offer.speaker: Posey
offer.text:
Oh no, oh no, oh no! What am I going to do?!

I wore Mother's Rain Amulet to the harvest dance, and a pack of Urchins snatched it right off my neck! They ran off to their cave south of the creek.

Mother comes home from market tomorrow. If that amulet isn't on its hook, I'll be scrubbing pig pens till I'm ninety! Will you get it back for me, kind sir?

refusal.speaker: Posey
refusal.text: Thank you for ruining a poor farm girl.

completion.speaker: Posey
completion.text:
Mother's amulet! You found it! Oh, thank goodness!

Here, take this Ankh. And please, not one word about this to Mother!

after.speaker: Posey
after.text:
Thanks again for the amulet! Mother never noticed a thing, not one single thing!

Bless you for your kindness!

journal.text: Posey has lost her mother's Rain Amulet to the Urchins, and her mother comes home tomorrow. Maybe the Urchins still have it in their cave...

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Posey's Rain Amulet has been returned before her mother came home.
